text:
sam_support: Merchant StripeEdge (ticket #8310) reports streaming completions with fncall -> truncated JSON payloads and occasional duplicate function_call frames; their webhook rejects both. Started after the recent flush optimization.

ellie_sales: StripeEdge is on Dedicated-us-east and blocked from launching new merchants. They want a short-term toggle and a clear timeline for a permanent fix.

nav_product: Need a minimal repro and error logs but based on past tickets likely framing + duplicate id problems. Suggested immediate mitigations: (1) opt-in atomic-frame header so server buffers until full JSON object, (2) short LRU dedupe window for tool_event ids behind a flag, (3) longer-term fix to emitter flush ordering.

tariq_eng: Estimates: atomic-header ~1.5 dev-days + QA; dedupe LRU ~1 dev-day; root fix 4-7 dev-days. Atomic header is fastest to unblock.

anya_pm: Proposed launch criteria for atomic header hotfix: unit + e2e tests for interleaved fncall/delta cases, staging validation with StripeEdge, 10% canary for 6h, runtime toggle for rollback and customer docs snippet. Need decision by EOD to hit this week's maintenance window.

ellie_sales: Customer asks for 1+2 (header + dedupe) if feasible. They'll enable toggles on Dedicated while we work the root fix.

nav_product: Decision: ship atomic-frame header now behind feature flag and follow with dedupe if dupes persist. Schedule root fix in next sprint. @tariq_eng please create issue and assign.

tariq_eng: Created GH #10456 "hotfix(streaming): opt-in atomic frame header" and assigning to zen_eng. ETA: start tonight, staging tomorrow. Adding metrics steam.atomic.buffered_count and stream.dedupe.count.

zen_eng: Taking it. Plan: header X-RW-Atomic-Frames: true -> buffer until balanced JSON object before emitting frame; add LRU dedupe keyed by event-id as quick follow-up if needed. Will post staging URL when ready.

anya_pm: I'll own the rollout checklist and customer comms. Sam, coordinate StripeEdge staging test and post results here.

sam_support: Will update ticket #8310 and coordinate their engineer for staging validation. Standing by for staging link.
